errors.text_span: for two audio-language models, MMAU and MMAR, evaluated on three distinct models: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies MMAU and MMAR as the models being evaluated. Based on the chart's structure and the paper's context (title: 'MMAR A Challenging Benchmark...'), MMAU and MMAR are the benchmarks, while Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni are the models being evaluated on those benchmarks. The description reverses these roles.
